Class Game

java.lang.Object
Game
public class Game extends Object
Controls the main game flow of a Texas Hold'em poker game. Manages rounds, betting, side pots, and winner determination.

startGame, startRound, and betRound were developed jointly by Nouri Ayadhi and Noah Ritter. All other methods written by Nouri Ayadhi.

Version:
1.0
Author:

  • Field Details

    • players

  • Method Details

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Starts the game by asking for the number of players and their names, then launches the first round.

    • startRound

      public void startRound()
      Sets up and runs a full round of the game. Deals cards, gives out blinds, runs all four betting phases, and triggers the showdown. Ends early if all but one player folds.

    • showdown

      public void showdown()
      Runs the showdown at the end of a round. Evaluates all remaining players' hands, determines the winner(s) per side pot, distributes chips, and shows the results.

    • betRound

      public void betRound()
      Runs a single betting phase. Asks each active player for their move in order until all players have acted. Ends the round early if only one player remains.

    • handleAction

      public void handleAction(Player player, PlayerMove move)
      Handles folding, calling, and raising including all-in situations.
      Parameters:
      player - the player who is acting
      move - the move the player made

    • determinedWinner

      public Player determinedWinner(Middle middle, ArrayList<Player> candidates)
      Determines the winner from a list of candidates by comparing hand types and tiebreak values.
      Parameters:
      middle - the community cards used for evaluation
      candidates - the players competing for this pot
      Returns:
      the winning Player

    • askForContinuation

      public void askForContinuation()
      Asks each player if they want to continue after a round ends. Removes players who quit and starts a new round, or ends the game if fewer than 2 players remain.

    • resetplayers

      public void resetplayers()
      Resets all players' state for a new round.

    • newLastRaiser

      public void newLastRaiser(Player player)
      Sets the given player as the last raiser and clears that flag for all others.
      Parameters:
      player - the player who just raised

    • noOneHasChecked

      public void noOneHasChecked()
      Resets the checked state for all players.

    • askForValidInt

      public Integer askForValidInt(String message, int min, int max)
      Prompts the user for an integer input within a given range. Repeats until a valid value is entered or the dialog is cancelled.
      Parameters:
      message - the prompt shown to the user
      min - the minimum accepted value
      max - the maximum accepted value
      Returns:
      the entered integer, or null if the user cancelled

    • createSidePots

      public ArrayList<SidePot> createSidePots()
      Creates side pots based on each player's total contribution to the pot. Used when one or more players are all-in with different amounts.
      Returns:
      a list of SidePot objects, each with an amount and eligible players
